name: (Gifts Rocket) Wallet Ready Gift Cards for WooCommerce
author: WebCartisan

sections.description:
Wallet Ready Gift Cards for WooCommerce helps you create gift card products, deliver PDFs by email, and let customers redeem balances at cart and checkout. Settings are grouped under WooCommerce > Gift Cards (General, gift card form, PDF and email design, and email delivery).

Useful links

  • Live demo
  • Documentation
  • Pro information

Free features (this plugin)

Included at no extra cost with Wallet Ready Gift Cards for WooCommerce:

  • PDF footer text (product short description)
  • Barcode, PDF417 & QR on downloadable PDFs (gift card number or apply-at-checkout link)
  • Optional full product description on the gift card product page
  • Live character counter for the gift message field
  • Custom label above the card design gallery
  • Gift card code display mask/pattern
  • Let buyers edit gift card details from the cart
  • Apply / redeem gift card codes from cart & checkout
  • Two-column layout: illustrated card vs. price & options (page & PDF)
  • Solid, gradient, image, or no background behind the card preview
  • Card layout borders and divider colors
  • Flexible and custom gift card amounts
  • Accordion / tab hover and active states
  • Custom form title and field labels (recipient, email, message, sender, etc.)
  • Maximum length for the personal message
  • Custom add to cart button text
  • Archive / shop loop button text for gift cards
  • Minimum and maximum custom amount limits
  • Cap on quantity added in a single add-to-cart
  • Fraud & abuse safeguards (rate limits, security audit log)
  • Separator between product title and card code in headings
  • Add multiple different gift cards from the product page
  • Schedule email delivery with date & time
  • Preset amounts plus enter-your-own pricing
  • Per-product expiry options for issued gift cards

Pro edition (separate add-on)

These capabilities are delivered by Wallet Ready Gift Cards for WooCommerce Pro (Pro information). Install the Pro plugin alongside this free plugin to enable them.

  • Edit gift card details during checkout
  • Buyer-uploaded custom images on the card (with cleanup of unused uploads)
  • Expiry reminder emails & scheduling
  • Preset greeting message snippets / quick-pick chips
  • Buyer partial-redemption UX: amount entry, preview, checkout & Blocks flows
  • Order rules: max gift cards per order and redemption amount caps (where configured)
  • Bulk issuance & CSV import for gift card codes
  • Outstanding balance / liability CSV export
  • WooCommerce REST API: gift card lookup & transactions (wc/v3 wallregi-giftcards routes)

Roadmap & upcoming ideas (not commitments)

The list below describes potential extensions, integrations, and longer-term research directions—including optional AI-assisted tools. Availability, licensing, and privacy terms may vary; nothing here is a guarantee of a future release.

  • Extended PDF & email designer polish (beyond current styling controls)
  • Apple Wallet & Google Wallet pass delivery (alongside PDF)
  • Curated card & PDF theme packs (pick a look without full CSS tweaking)
  • Admin: preview recipient email & PDF with sample merge data
  • Marketing automation events (received, redeemed, balance low)
  • Deeper WooCommerce Store API & headless/mobile patterns (beyond wc/v3 REST)
  • Role-based purchase limits & B2B-style rules (beyond current caps)
  • Gift card bundles & composite product patterns
  • POS / gateway companion patterns (documented integration paths)
  • Category-based design image sets
  • More notification channels (SMS, WhatsApp where supported)
  • Balance top-up and hybrid redeem flows
  • Additional flexible redemption modes
  • Stronger multilingual, multi-currency & RTL PDF/email polish
  • High-volume email queue & deliverability hardening
  • Formal accessibility audit (WCAG-minded forms, modals, PDF text)
  • AI: draft or refine greeting text (tone, length, occasion) — shopper approves before send
  • AI: generate custom card imagery from prompts or brand color palette
  • AI: suggest email subject lines & short body copy for gift delivery
  • AI: translate the personal message for the recipient locale (optional)
  • AI: suggest amounts or contextual upsell hints on the gift card product
  • AI: seasonal or campaign-matched imagery & copy variants
  • AI optional: light moderation flags on buyer-submitted message text

External services

dompdf

This plugin bundles dompdf (see dompdf on GitHub) to generate gift card PDFs on your server. PDF generation uses your product, order, and customer-related data already present in WordPress/WooCommerce. No PDF content is sent to dompdf’s maintainers as part of normal operation; processing stays on your hosting unless you add other integrations.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Install and activate WooCommerce (required).
  4. Open WooCommerce > Gift Cards to configure general settings, the gift card form, PDF/email design, and delivery.
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin checks for WooCommerce and shows an admin notice if it is missing.

Can I customize the PDF and on-page gift card appearance?

Yes. You can adjust layout options, backgrounds, borders, colors, labels, and related styling from the plugin settings (see PDF & email card design and related sections).

Can customers personalize gift cards?

Yes. Buyers can set recipient details, personal messages, amounts (where allowed), delivery scheduling, and card design choices from the product options. Buyer-uploaded images are part of the Pro add-on; see the Pro section above. Roadmap items are not guaranteed features.

Can gift card balances be used across more than one order?

When a gift card covers only part of the cart total, the unused balance remains on the card for future orders until it is fully used (subject to expiry and your product settings).

Can I create or adjust gift cards in the admin?

Yes. The plugin includes admin tools for managing gift cards (including manual issuance where supported).

Can I schedule when the gift email is sent?

Yes. Customers can schedule email delivery with a date and time where you enable that option.

Can I limit amounts or how many cards are added at once?

Yes. You can set minimum and maximum custom amounts and cap quantity per add-to-cart action in the settings.

How do gift cards relate to WooCommerce coupons?

Gift cards are applied through this plugin’s gift card flow (balance applied to the order). Standard WooCommerce coupons are separate; whether both apply on the same order depends on your store, theme, and other plugins—verify behavior on a staging checkout.
